why_it_matters: DPO changes the acting policy using pairs of preferred and dispreferred responses.
Trusted monitoring and editing can change which outputs are accepted while the acting model stays fixed.
CaMeL separates trusted control flow from untrusted data and mediates tool access.
AgentSpec expresses conditions and enforcement actions for an agent at runtime.
SHE revises prompts and tool policies after failures. The object being adapted is the harness.
DeAL changes decoding to favor alignment objectives. A preference signal and an enforceable constraint do different jobs.
Pluralistic alignment asks which preferences an AI should represent. It informs both training and supervision.
